scripts.cloudflare:db:create: pnpm --filter @hotkey-tools/worker exec wrangler d1 create hotkey-tools
scripts.cloudflare:db:migrate:local: pnpm --filter @hotkey-tools/worker exec wrangler d1 migrations apply hotkey-tools --local
scripts.cloudflare:db:migrate: node scripts/check-cloudflare.mjs && pnpm --filter @hotkey-tools/worker exec wrangler d1 migrations apply hotkey-tools --remote
scripts.deploy: node scripts/check-cloudflare.mjs && pnpm --filter @hotkey-tools/python run deploy && pnpm --filter @hotkey-tools/worker run deploy
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm --filter @hotkey-tools/web build && pnpm --filter @hotkey-tools/python run deploy:dry-run && pnpm --filter @hotkey-tools/worker run deploy:dry-run
